timing: Follow-up audit plan written during fresh generation, before any primary review returned; the development case set was already frozen. Not a preregistered primary-study endpoint.
selection: Every one of the 100 frozen development cases, all five fresh answers: 500 candidate annotations. No outcome filtering.
reviewers: Three existing model assistants, assigned locales different from their original case authorship; run one at a time only after CLI workers finish. No human/native-speaker certification; immutable reviewer snapshot not exposed.
publication: Keep all annotations, including disagreements and uncertain judgments. Release the opaque key only after all three assistants finish and complete coverage is validated. Keep original strict scores unchanged.
selection_rule: All frozen development cases and all five candidates, without filtering by any result.
